_note: plausible_min/plausible_max are INPUT-VALIDATION limits used only to reject impossible or mistyped values (e.g. a heart rate of 900). They are NOT clinical thresholds and are never used to label a value abnormal.

indicators.name: Heart rate
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Number of heartbeats per minute.
indicators.measurement_instructions: Record resting heart rate after sitting/resting quietly for several minutes, or record the activity context (exercise, post-exercise). Note the device used.
indicators.limitations: Varies with activity, posture, stress, caffeine and time of day. Wearable optical sensors can be affected by motion and fit.

indicators.name: Systolic blood pressure
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Peak arterial pressure during heart contraction.
indicators.measurement_instructions: Rest quietly, use the correct cuff size and position, record both systolic and diastolic values together with the time and device.
indicators.limitations: Cuff size, position, movement, talking and recent activity affect the reading.

indicators.name: Diastolic blood pressure
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Arterial pressure between heartbeats.
indicators.measurement_instructions: Recorded together with systolic pressure in the same measurement.

indicators.name: Oxygen saturation (SpO2)
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Estimated percentage of haemoglobin carrying oxygen, measured by pulse oximetry.
indicators.measurement_instructions: Keep the finger warm and still; wait for a stable reading; note signal quality.
indicators.limitations: Cold fingers, motion, nail polish and poor perfusion reduce accuracy.

indicators.name: Respiratory rate
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Breaths per minute.
indicators.measurement_instructions: Count breaths for a full 60 seconds at rest, or use a validated wearable estimate and record the method.
indicators.limitations: Conscious awareness changes breathing; wearable estimates are approximate.

indicators.name: Body temperature
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Body temperature. Fahrenheit inputs are converted to Celsius; the original value and unit are preserved.
indicators.measurement_instructions: Use the same method (oral, tympanic, skin) consistently and record it. Avoid measuring right after exercise or hot drinks.
indicators.limitations: Method, time of day and recent exercise affect readings. Temperature alone cannot establish infection or immune dysfunction.

indicators.name: Blood glucose
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Blood glucose concentration. Monitoring is configured per astronaut by medical personnel; it is not a mandatory routine measurement for every crew member.
indicators.measurement_instructions: Follow the clinician-directed schedule. Record context (fasting, before/after meal, after exercise) and device or laboratory source.
indicators.limitations: Strongly affected by meals, exercise and timing; meter accuracy varies.

indicators.name: Sleep duration
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Total time asleep in a sleep period (calculated from start/end times, corrected for interruptions when reported).
indicators.measurement_instructions: Log sleep start and end. If sleep was interrupted, correct the total sleep time.
indicators.limitations: Self-reported and wearable estimates differ from laboratory polysomnography.

indicators.name: Sleep quality
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Self-rated sleep quality on a five-level descriptive scale.

indicators.name: Awakenings
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Number of awakenings during the sleep period, if known.

indicators.name: Scheduled sleep opportunity
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Length of the sleep period allotted by the mission schedule.

indicators.name: Mood
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Self-reported mood (five-level descriptive scale). A self-reported indicator, not a psychiatric diagnosis.
indicators.measurement_instructions: Private daily check-in; may be skipped.

indicators.name: Perceived stress
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Self-reported perceived stress.
indicators.measurement_instructions: Private daily check-in; may be skipped.

indicators.name: Fatigue
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Self-reported fatigue.
indicators.measurement_instructions: Private daily check-in or after waking; may be skipped.

indicators.name: Mental workload
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: How mentally demanding the day's workload was.

indicators.name: Social connectedness
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Self-reported connectedness to the crew.

indicators.name: Reaction-time test (mean)
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Mean reaction time on a psychomotor-vigilance-style test (optional cognitive assessment).
indicators.measurement_instructions: Use the same test, device and duration each time; record the test name.
indicators.limitations: Practice effects, motivation and device latency affect results.

indicators.name: Exercise session duration
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Duration of an exercise session (type, intensity and completion status in context).
indicators.measurement_instructions: Logged from the exercise device or manually.
indicators.limitations: Adherence is NOT a measurement of bone density or muscle mass.

indicators.name: Physical performance test
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Result of a physical performance test. The test name is stored in context (e.g. grip_strength in kg). Only compared with earlier results of the same test.
indicators.measurement_instructions: Use a consistent protocol; record the test name and unit.

indicators.name: Pain
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Self-reported pain intensity (0 none – 10 worst imaginable) with location in context.

indicators.name: Mobility limitation
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Whether the astronaut reports a mobility limitation.

indicators.name: Specialized bone assessment
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Clinician-entered result of a specialized bone examination (e.g. densitometry).
indicators.limitations: Requires specialized equipment, often only on Earth.

indicators.name: Laboratory result
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Clinician-entered laboratory result with test name, value, unit and the laboratory's own reference range.

indicators.name: Immune assessment
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Clinician-entered immune assessment.

indicators.name: Reported vision change
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Self-reported change in vision.
indicators.measurement_instructions: Describe in notes (near/far vision, blur, field).

indicators.name: Eye examination
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Clinician-performed eye examination result.

indicators.name: Imaging result
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Ultrasound or other imaging result (modality, region, findings text).

indicators.name: Motion sickness
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Self-reported motion sickness (None/Mild/Moderate/Severe).

indicators.name: Balance assessment
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Result of a balance test; test name in context. Compared only with earlier results of the same test.

indicators.name: Coordination / hand-eye test
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Result of a coordination or hand-eye coordination test; test name in context.

indicators.name: Water intake
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Water/fluid intake for one entry; daily totals are calculated.
indicators.measurement_instructions: Log each drink or use the dispenser record.

indicators.name: Food energy intake
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Energy content of a logged meal, when known from the food system.
indicators.limitations: Incomplete logs cannot establish nutrient deficiency.

indicators.name: Appetite
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: Self-reported appetite.

indicators.name: Symptom report
indicators.subject: astronaut
indicators.description: A reported symptom (code from the ASTRA symptom vocabulary) with severity 1–5 and onset time in context.
indicators.limitations: Subjective; symptoms are evaluated with measurements, never diagnosed alone.

indicators.name: Cabin CO2 partial pressure
indicators.subject: environment
indicators.description: ppCO2 in the habitable volume measured by an environmental sensor. Environmental reading, not a medical measurement.
indicators.limitations: Local CO2 pockets can differ from module sensor readings.

indicators.name: Cabin O2 partial pressure
indicators.subject: environment
indicators.description: ppO2 in the habitable volume.

indicators.name: Cabin temperature
indicators.subject: environment
indicators.description: Cabin air temperature.

indicators.name: Cabin relative humidity
indicators.subject: environment
indicators.description: Cabin relative humidity.

indicators.name: Total volatile organic compounds
indicators.subject: environment
indicators.description: Air-quality indicator from an environmental sensor. No ASTRA threshold is defined; trends are shown for review.
indicators.limitations: Aggregate measure; does not identify specific compounds.

indicators.name: Particulate matter (PM2.5)
indicators.subject: environment
indicators.description: Air-quality indicator from an environmental sensor. No ASTRA threshold is defined; trends are shown for review.
indicators.limitations: Sensor calibration in microgravity is not established.

indicators.name: Radiation dose rate
indicators.subject: both
indicators.description: Absorbed dose rate from a personal dosimeter (astronaut) or area monitor (environment).
indicators.limitations: Absorbed dose (Gy) is not equivalent to effective dose (Sv).

indicators.name: Accumulated radiation dose
indicators.subject: both
indicators.description: Accumulated absorbed dose reported by a dosimeter for the mission.
